model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 401 North Elm Street in Tuskegee, Alabama, as the "Tuskegee Airmen Memorial Post Office".
model.meta: Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Shomari Figures (D-AL)

summary.text: The bill would rename the U.S. Postal Service facility at 401 North Elm Street in Tuskegee, Alabama, as the "Tuskegee Airmen Memorial Post Office" to honor the historic aviators.
